purpose: Overview requirements for the doc-link plugin: purpose, glossary, scope, shared non-functional requirements, error classes, and the decision and open-issue registers that govern the split requirement documents.
summary: Purpose and background of replacing DocAdvisor with ID-based document management
Overall flow diagrams for introduction, operation, change notification, and document search
Glossary of terms such as DLID, document ID, section ID, ToC, content hash, and index target list
Scope: included and excluded items, and responsibility boundary between doc-link and the project management AI
Non-functional requirements: rebuild consistency, determinism, idempotency, write boundary, diagnosability, resumability, scalability
Error candidates and findings that do not block ToC confirmation
Decision register D-001 to D-058 covering DLID format, write rules, hashing, references, search policy, and operation flow
Open-issue register with decided outcomes and design-deferred items
tasks: Understanding the overall goals and scope of doc-link
Looking up glossary term definitions before writing specifications
Checking decision records before changing requirements or design
Designing or implementing DLID assignment and write-boundary behavior
Implementing ToC build, rebuild, and consistency checks
Implementing change impact notification and reference checks
Defining error handling and validation of AI-generated fields
title: doc-link 要件定義書 — 総論
